name: iPhone Duo
notes: Book-style foldable, hinge on the left of the outer display. Outer: punch-hole camera top right (Dynamic Island runs down the right edge, drawn by iOS, 37 x 137 pt). Inner: 951 x 669 pt at 3x rendered and scaled to the 430 ppi panel, under-display camera, no cutout. Outer landscape and inner portrait insets unverified.

virtual.note: Derived from Apple's iPhone 16 research variant. One fixed panel with the folded display's pixels; folding and the second display are not emulated.

back.note: Seen from behind the hinge is on the right; the camera sits in the opposite top corner: a raised base, a stadium with two lenses, microphone and flash (Apple's dimensional drawing).

openBack.note: Open, from behind: the camera half on the left, the outer display on the right half with its small corners at the hinge.

provenance.body: official: https://www.apple.com/iphone-duo/specs/ and https://developer.apple.com/accessories/dimensional-drawings/ (iphone-duo.pdf): outer bezel 2.71 mm, 4.13 mm at the hinge; inner bezel 3.45 mm
provenance.bodyRadius: measured: Apple's continuous curve (tangent 1.5287 r) fitted to the corner profile, detail A, of https://developer.apple.com/accessories/dimensional-drawings/ (iphone-duo.pdf): tangent 17.31 mm, r = 11.32 mm; hinge corners from detail AY, tangent 3.72 mm, about 2.5 mm
provenance.border: official: 2.71 mm housing edge to active area less the 1.33 mm housing edge to cover glass in the drawing
provenance.points: measured: Xcode 27 simulator via https://iosref.com/res and https://safearea.info/iphone-duo: outer 466 x 678, inner 951 x 669 (3x, native scale 2.807)
provenance.cutout: official: camera opening 6.07 mm, centre 73.39 mm from the hinge edge and 10.62 mm from the top in https://developer.apple.com/accessories/dimensional-drawings/; island size measured https://safearea.info/iphone-duo
provenance.radius: measured: simulator 59 pt (8 pt at the hinge) outer, 55 pt inner https://github.com/expo/expo-device-hub/pull/514
provenance.safeArea: measured: iOS 27.1 simulator https://safearea.info/iphone-duo (outer portrait and inner landscape: right 84, bottom 34); outer landscape and inner portrait kept, unverified
provenance.innerCamera: official: under-display camera 115.80 mm from the left and 10.55 mm from the top, open, in https://developer.apple.com/accessories/dimensional-drawings/
provenance.colors: official names https://www.apple.com/iphone-duo/specs/; hex: Apple compare-page swatches https://www.apple.com/v/iphone/compare/an/built/styles/overview.built.css
